Hey!

Want to participate or learn more about it?

npcSpawnDialog.description:
Oh, have you already used up all the time given to you?!
Well, come back after 5 AM, and I will add more for you — drive to your heart's content!

Time will be added to the timer after 5:00 MSK.

npcSpawnDialog.title: Moon
npcSpawnDialog.description: Hey, you are participating in the race! The timer is ticking! Get back in your car!

hintGpsButton.text:
Take part in the “Road Rally”, make it into the top, and get rewards!
Until %s

sideHints.comment: Side hint about leaving the starting zone. Spawns after the player appears in the starting zone. Automatically hides after leaving the starting zone
sideHints.text: Leave the starting zone! You have %d s before disqualification.

sideHints.comment: Side hint when the player exits the vehicle during a run; if the player manages to return, hide it automatically
sideHints.text: Return to the vehicle, or the run will end in %d s.

hints.comment: client notification, the player did not manage to leave the starting zone and the run ended
hints.text: You did not manage to leave the starting zone, and the run was ended. Talk to Luna to start a run.

hints.comment: client notification when the run starts - the player leaves the starting zone
hints.text: The run has started! Show your best result!

hints.comment: client notification, the player did not manage to return to the vehicle during the run and the run ended
hints.text: You left the vehicle, and the run was ended. Talk to Luna to start a run.

hints.comment: client notification when 15 sec remain on the main timer during the run

hintButton.comment: client notification when the run ends after the main timer expires or by the player's decision - command or button in HUD
hintButton.text: Run finished, your result is %.2f km

oldHudModal.text: The old interface engine is not supported in this event. Switch to the new engine for an improved gameplay experience

oldHudMessage: To finish the run, use the command /finish
confirmModalText: Are you sure you want to finish the run? The remaining time on the timer will be saved.
